$comment: Example profile for scripts/report.mjs. Copy this, replace with your own dog, and keep it out of the repo if you'd rather not publish it. Scores are whatever your chosen instrument produces — keep the instrument consistent across reviews so the trend means something.

medications.name: Omega-3 (EPA/DHA)
medications.reason: Adjunct for osteoarthritis; aiming to reduce carprofen dose

medications.name: Glucosamine/chondroitin chew
medications.reason: Started before diagnosis — discuss whether to stop

questions: Can we attempt a carprofen dose reduction now that she has been on the omega-3 diet for six months?
Is the glucosamine chew worth continuing given the 2022 meta-analysis?

mobility-pain.notes: Slow to rise in the mornings.

body-condition.notes: Deliberate weight loss on a measured diet. Muscle condition normal. Past the 6% threshold where the trials showed lameness improvement.

mobility-pain.notes: Rising faster, using stairs again, walk length up. Consistent with the weight loss and the omega-3 diet.

cognition.notes: More night waking than February; twice found standing in the hallway at night.
flags: Increased night waking and reversed sleep pattern — rule out pain and sensory loss before attributing to cognition

thirst-urination.notes: Up substantially since February. Weather was warm during the measurement week.
flags: Water intake rising toward the 100 ml/kg/day threshold — repeat measurement and check urine specific gravity

bloodwork.notes: All still within reference range but all three have moved in the same direction since February, while on an NSAID.
flags: Creatinine and SDMA rising and USG falling on long-term carprofen — discuss recheck interval and dose

oral-health.notes: Dental performed in April; much improved.
